fields.description: Unique identifier of the offline command sent from the mobile app, used to deduplicate on sync.
fields.label: Command ID

fields.description: Technician or user whose device issued this command.
fields.label: User

fields.description: Operation the mobile app requested, such as check-in or status update.
fields.label: Action

fields.description: Type of record the command acts on, for example Service Visit.
fields.label: Entity Type

fields.description: Identifier of the specific record targeted by the command.
fields.label: Entity ID

fields.description: Sync state of the command, either still processing or successfully synced.
fields.label: State

fields.description: Server response payload returned after the command was processed.
fields.label: Result JSON

fields.description: Error detail recorded if the command failed to process.
fields.label: Error
